# DataForSEO Backlinks Page Intersection API

Referring pages that link to all (or some) of up to 20 target pages or domains.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/backlinks/page_intersection/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/page_intersection/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"targets": {"1": "https://www.nike.com/", "2": "https://www.adidas.com/"}, "limit": 10}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `targets` | Object of up to 20 targets keyed "1", "2", ... (pages or domains). |
| `limit` | Maximum number of referring pages to return. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/backlinks/page_intersection/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.02436 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
